evaluation: Original C, Y20, Y500 unchanged, plus common 45 s completion view for all original and robust methods. Original full-cost baselines retained.
primary: Robust CAD hold-by-wait interaction on Y500 within 45 s; preserve capability and report healthy controls and all timeouts.
comparison: Reuse the exact original shared-prefix CAD/Landmark cohort, no new baseline execution.
stopping: Freeze once a capable development variant is obtained; run all 240 formal conditions, without outcome-based extension. No more than 400 new formal runs across both routes.
development_choice: Initial visual table-leveling development variant reduced capability and was rejected before formal execution; retained in development-leveling. Final variant preserves all original placement, targets and wrists, adding bounded arrival-conditioned settling before closing.
nonpreemptive_service: A query started before the deadline completes and is fully charged; an unavoidable overrun is retained and fails the common budget view.

development_result.interpretation: Engineering ability check, not an equivalence test. No tuning on formal seeds or outcomes.
